title: Boomerang-shaped craft over Tucson

tellings.quote: Oh, yeah. My wife and I did in Tucson, Arizona. Broad daylight. A boomerang shaped craft below traffic pattern altitude.

plain: A boomerang-shaped craft flew over Tucson, Arizona, in broad daylight, lower than the height planes use when circling to land at an airport. Eric W. Davis, introduced in the episode as a Pentagon scientist, says he and his wife saw it themselves. He brings it up as his own sighting, with no date given.
